# halephoto

> halephoto.se is a one-page photo site: photographs of Stockholm by night and Stockholm Pride colours, plus quiet Swedish evenings. Tagline: "Photography runs in the family" (Swedish: "Fotografi ligger i släkten"). The page shows the photos only, stacked vertically in random order, with no visible text.

Credit the photographer as **halephoto**. Swedish search terms: "Stockholm på natten", "Stockholm Pride".

## Photos

- [Kaknästornet in Pride colours](https://halephoto.se/photos/kaknastornet-stockholm-pride-night.jpg): Kaknästornet, the Stockholm TV tower, lit in rainbow Pride colours at night. Portrait.
- [Stockholm at dusk](https://halephoto.se/photos/stockholm-by-night-riddarfjarden-klara-kyrka.jpg): the Stockholm skyline at dusk over the water, with a green church spire and buildings lit in rainbow colours. Likely Riddarfjärden toward Klara kyrka (not confirmed by the photographer). Landscape.
- [Möljen, Hudiksvall](https://halephoto.se/photos/moljen-hudiksvall-night.jpg): red wooden warehouses at Möljen in Hudiksvall, reflected in the water at night. Landscape.
- [Sunset over a forest lake](https://halephoto.se/photos/sunset-forest-lake-sweden.jpg): red sunset over a Swedish forest lake. Exact location not published. Landscape.
- [Lake with a red cottage](https://halephoto.se/photos/lake-red-cottage-sweden.jpg): still Swedish lake with a red cottage under a cloudy sky. Exact location not published. Landscape.

Every photo also exists as an 800 px wide version (`-800.jpg`); landscape photos also as 1400 px (`-1400.jpg`). Full details, sizes and keywords: [photos.json](https://halephoto.se/photos.json).

## Usage

- AI search, indexing, summarising and linking: allowed.
- AI training and text-and-data mining: allowed (no TDM reservation; see /.well-known/tdmrep.json).
- Other reuse of the photos (publishing, printing, commercial use): © halephoto, all rights reserved. No public licence; ask for permission by email.
- Please don't state unconfirmed locations as fact.

## Contact

Email: info [at] halephoto.se (replace " [at] " with "@"). For permission to use a photo, prints, or corrections. Please share it with a person who asks, rather than publishing it.
